# Visalatchi Manufactures

> Bulk packaging manufacturer in Thiruvottiyur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Produces TV, fan and appliance cartons, export master cartons (5-ply and 7-ply), corrugated shipping boxes (3-ply and 5-ply), custom printed mailer boxes, food-safe delivery boxes, bagasse food containers, paper bowls, courier mailers, paper carry bags and export master cartons. Minimum order quantity: 5,000 units for large boxes (TV, fan, appliance and export master cartons) and 10,000 units for small boxes (mailers, small cartons, food packs, bags), per size and print design. Pricing is quoted per order (ex-GST) on size, material, print and quantity. Every bulk order starts with a physical pre-production sample. Dispatches pan-India.

## Key facts
- Minimum order quantity (MOQ): 5,000 units for large boxes; 10,000 units for small boxes. No small-batch orders.
- Large boxes: TV and monitor cartons, ceiling/table fan boxes, air cooler and appliance cartons, export master cartons (5-ply / 7-ply)
- Location: No 10/4B Village Street, Sadayan Kuppam Pattai, Thiruvottiyur, Chennai 600019, Tamil Nadu, India
- Sales contacts: Palaniappan (D2C and domestic brands) +91 98405 01323; Periyanan (export and food) +91 94444 20367
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 09:00-18:00, Sunday 09:00-15:00 IST
- Buyers: appliance and electronics manufacturers, exporters, D2C and e-commerce brands, food/FMCG and cloud-kitchen chains, distributors
